description: This file provides an API for interacting with the Soong build system, including functions for executing commands, querying variables, cleaning build outputs, and building targets.

classes.name: Soong
classes.description: A class providing an interface to interact with the Soong build system, including methods to run commands, get variables, clean build outputs, and build targets.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Soong object with build top directory and output directory paths.

methods.name: soong_ui
methods.description: Executes the soong_ui.bash script with specified arguments and environment, returning the output.

methods.name: get_make_var
methods.description: Queries the build system for the value of a specified make variable.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes the output directory if it exists.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds specified targets, creating the output directory if necessary.
